bank: "O'zbekiston Respublikasi tashqi iqtisodiy faoliyat milliy banki" AJ (JSC "National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity of the Republic of Uzbekistan", NBU) va sho'ba korxonalari

2020.hujjat: JSC "National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity of the Republic of Uzbekistan". Consolidated financial statements and independent auditor's report for the year ended 31 December 2021 (yuklab olingan, 2020 TA/EQ hali o'qilmagan - to'liq emas)

2021.hujjat: JSC "National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity of the Republic of Uzbekistan". Consolidated financial statements and independent auditor's report for the year ended 31 December 2022 (2021 qiyosiy ma'lumoti)

2022.hujjat: NBU consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2023 (skaner, 92 bet; yuklab olingan, hali o'qilmagan)

2023.hujjat: NBU consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 (openinfo.uz, skaner, 85 bet; yuklab olingan, hali o'qilmagan)

2024.hujjat: NBU 2025 yil auditor xulosasi + asosiy shakllar (openinfo.uz 'Audition', 2026-06-23, skaner, 15 bet - izohlarsiz; yuklab olingan, hali o'qilmagan)

2025.hujjat: NBU 2025 yil auditor xulosasi + asosiy shakllar (openinfo.uz, skaner, 15 bet - izohlarsiz; hali o'qilmagan)

izohlar: TO'LIQ EMAS (ish koordinator so'rovi bilan to'xtatildi). Hozircha faqat 2021 yil 2022 hisobotidagi qiyosiy ma'lumotdan to'ldirildi; 2020 va 2022-2025 yillar null. USUL: har yil keyingi yil hisobotidan (2025/2024 - 2025 hisobotidan, 2023 - 2024, 2022 - 2023, 2021 - 2022, 2020 - 2021). BIRLIK: millions of Uzbek Soums -> mlrd so'm (/1000). 2021: S1/S2/S3 - 8-izohdagi segmentlar bo'yicha brutto qiymat harakati jadvallarining '1 January 2022' qatorlari yig'indisi (davlat kompaniyalari, xususiy kompaniyalar, davlat byudjeti/mahalliy hokimiyat, moliyaviy lizing, nobank moliya institutlari, jismoniy shaxslar; jami 76356.9 = brutto kreditlar); 28-izohdagi kredit sifati jadvali (bet 55) sof (ECL chegirilgan) qiymatlarda va bosqichlar bo'yicha boshqacha taqsimotni ko'rsatadi (S1 61470.8, S2 8884.5, S3 1734.4, jami = sof kreditlar 72089.7) - ishlatilmadi. ECL = 4267.2 (allowance for impairment). KAPITAL: 36-izoh, Basel Capital Accord 1988 asosida (CAP_BASIS=Basel): Total capital ratio 21%, Tier 1 ratio 18% (butun foizda berilgan); CBU milliy me'yorlari oshkor qilinmagan; RWA summasi oshkor qilinmagan. LEV: hisobotda faqat 'Debt-to-Equity ratio' 5.53 (marta) berilgan - leverage % emas, shuning uchun null. LCR/NSFR oshkor qilinmagan. FX ulushlari: 28-izoh valyuta riski jadvali (bet 60), moliyaviy aktiv/majburiyatlar: FX_LOANS_SHARE = (USD+EUR+boshqa) sof kreditlar / jami sof kreditlar; FX_LIAB_SHARE = xorijiy valyutadagi moliyaviy majburiyatlar / jami moliyaviy majburiyatlar (74496.9; balansdagi jami majburiyatlar 74736.5). FX_NET = dealing + translation differences. OTHER_INC = 'Other income' (24-izoh); nobank faoliyat daromadi (338.9) kiritilmagan. OPEX = 'Personnel and other operating expenses'. MANBALAR HOLATI: nbu.uz proksi orqali uzilib qoladi (ws_closed); 2021-2023 hisobotlari new.nbu.uz/assets/ dan, 2024 va 2025 openinfo.uz dan olindi. 2023, 2024 hisobotlari to'liq skaner (matn qatlamisiz); 2025 yil uchun openinfo.uz da faqat 15 betlik auditor xulosasi + asosiy shakllar topildi (izohlarsiz) - 2025 izoh ko'rsatkichlari (bosqichlar, kapital, valyuta) to'liq hisobot topilmaguncha null bo'ladi.
